alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A room with a small table and a chair on each side, both standing crooked. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the far left with narrowed eyes. It leans toward the left chair and the chair snaps upright, then toward the right chair and that one straightens too. Each time its eyes turn happy with a small pulse, and at the end it pulses with happy eyes and looks to the camera.
